description: REPO_VALIDATED tier vocabulary (T0-T6, TX, TU from approval_policy.yaml + policy.py) / PROVISIONAL for Dopetask and bridge postures. Classifies mutation posture and required gating WITHOUT performing mutation. LIVE_WRITE_READY is undefined and must not be introduced. DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 is a hard-block class. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

authority_notes.description: Notes on authority sources and derivation rationale.

classes.description: Registry of mutation class entries. Each class classifies a mutation posture without performing mutation.

allowed_in_v1.description: Whether DCP may execute this class in .v1 (with appropriate gating). False = deferred or hard-blocked beyond .v1.

approval_tier.description: Approval tier required for this mutation class per approval_policy.yaml. HARD_BLOCK = forbidden. PROVISIONAL = tier not yet resolved from repo authority.

canonical_writer_required.description: The canonical writer that must own this mutation surface, or null if not applicable.

class_id.description: Unique class identifier (e.g. MC-READ-ONLY, MC-T4-SOURCE, MC-MERGE-SEAM-FORBIDDEN).

description.description: Full description of this mutation posture.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for this mutation class.

dry_run_required.description: Whether a dry-run preview is required before execution.

live_write_ready_required.description: Whether LIVE_WRITE_READY gate must be defined before this class may be used. True for any actual mutation class. LIVE_WRITE_READY remains undefined in .v0.

mutation_surface.description: What surface or resource this class may mutate (or 'none' for read-only).

proof_required.description: Whether a proof artifact is required before this class may be executed.

provenance.description: Provenance of this specific class entry.

red_lane_triggers.description: Red lane IDs that are triggered or must be checked for this mutation class.

side_effect_posture.description: Side-effect posture. 'hard_block' means this class is absolutely forbidden for DCP to perform.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for this contract instance.

contract_status.description: Lifecycle status of this contract. Not the same as validation_state or proof freshness.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags for all top-level fields.

known_unknowns.description: Explicit list of unresolved unknowns for this contract.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance per REV1 §6.0. REPO_VALIDATED: tier vocabulary derived from config/orchestrator/approval_policy.yaml + src/dopemux/orchestrator/policy.py.

red_lines.description: Red line IDs that apply to this contract. Must include DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

supersedes.description: Contract ID(s) superseded by this contract, or null if none.

validation.description: Validation status per REV1 §6.0. REPO_CROSS_CHECKED: tier ID vocabulary verified against approval_policy.yaml and policy.py in origin/main.

state.description: REPO_CROSS_CHECKED for the contract's tier vocabulary; individual PROVISIONAL classes carry their own provenance.

validation_state.description: Top-level contract enforcement state. REPO_CROSS_CHECKED: tier vocab verified against repo sources. Individual classes may be PROVISIONAL — see per-class provenance field.

title: DCP Mutation Class Registry (.v0)
